record_title: Isolated triad-triplet oscillations leak outside finite Fourier support
provenance: A source-specific correction to arXiv:2609.20710v1. The periodic seven-mode isolated triad-triplet orbit is exact for the displayed reduced ODE, but a cross-triplet interaction in the paper's own parameter example forces a Fourier mode outside the retained set, so the finite reconstruction is not an exact full-Euler solution.
limitations: The explicit leakage calculation uses the source's Fig. 2 / Sec. IV.2 parameter set and corrects the isolated finite-triplet claim only. It does not classify exceptional affine geometries or assess the separate infinite-chain/fractal ansatz. General finite-mode Euler classification and Galerkin nonclosure principles are prior art.
